Connection.description: Connection is one entry of the recent-connections ring buffer: the full per-connection record, including the requested host even when denied and the resolved IP, which never appear as metric labels.

server.description: Server is the control plane's base URL (http(s)://host[:port][/prefix]).

signal_url.description:
SignalURL is the signalling WebSocket URL, when it is not the
conventional {server}/v1/signal.

peer_id.description: PeerID is this peer's id, when already known.

network.description: Network is the network to join.

Creds.description:
credsConfig is a peer's control-plane credentials: the creds object
ghost_enroll returns, plus the server it came from.

server.description:
Server is the control plane's base URL. The server does not return it;
ghost_enroll records it so the creds are usable on their own.

public_key.description: PublicKey is the WireGuard key registered for the peer, when one was.

EnrollCreds.description:
enrollCreds is what the control plane returns, plus the server it came
from. It is exactly the creds object a start config takes.

server.description: Server is the control plane's base URL, e.g. "https://ghost.example.com".

name.description: Name is the peer's display name in netmaps.

labels.description: Labels are free-form key/value labels the control plane records.

key_store_path.description:
KeyStorePath is where the WireGuard key pair lives. The public key is
registered at enrolment, so this should be the same path the start
config later uses; the file is created when it is missing.

public_key.description:
PublicKey registers a key the caller already holds, instead of
KeyStorePath. Leaving both empty enrols without a key.

private_key.description:
PrivateKey registers the public half of a private key the caller
keeps in its own secret store; nothing is written to disk. When
PublicKey is also given the two must be a pair.

ca_cert_pem.description:
CACertPEM holds PEM certificate authorities trusted, on top of the
system roots, for a control plane behind a private CA.

EnrollRequest.description: enrollRequestJSON is the JSON body of ghost_enroll.

EnrollResponse.description: enrollResponse is the JSON ghost_enroll returns.

Error.description: errorResponse is what a call that returns JSON reports a failure with.

seq.description:
Seq numbers events per node, from 1, and counts the dropped ones, so a
gap in Seq is exactly what Dropped reports.

kind.description:
Kind is one of signal_state, joined, netmap, policy, peer_connected,
peer_disconnected, error, stopped.

time.description: Time is when the event was buffered (RFC 3339, UTC).

dropped.description:
Dropped is how many events were dropped, oldest first, between the
previous delivered event and this one. It is 0 in the normal case.

signal_state.description:
SignalState is set on signal_state: disconnected, connecting,
connected or closed.

peer_id.description:
PeerID is the peer an event concerns (peer_connected,
peer_disconnected, and some errors).

address.description:
Address is a tunnel address in CIDR form: this node's on joined, the
peer's on peer_connected.

candidate_type.description:
CandidateType is the selected local ICE candidate type on
peer_connected: host, srflx, prflx or relay.

policy.description: Policy is the control plane's new exit policy on policy.

error.description: Error is the message on error.

Event.description:
eventJSON is one entry of the event stream, the JSON ghost_next_event_json
returns. Fields that do not apply to a kind are omitted.

port.description: Port is the tunnel-side TCP port (0 = exit.DefaultPort).

allow.description:
Allow is the local allowlist ("host", "host:port", "*.example.com:443").
Absent leaves the control plane's allowlist alone; an empty array denies
everything.

daily_bytes.description: DailyBytes and BytesPerSecond are local caps (0 = no local cap).

paused.description: Paused refuses new exit connections while true.

ExitConfig.description:
exitConfig configures a node's exit. Allow, DailyBytes, BytesPerSecond and
Paused are the local policy: they narrow the control plane's, they never
widen it, and ghost_set_policy replaces them later.

listen.description:
Listen is the tunnel-side address the exit serves on, empty until the
node has joined; Port is the port it will use.

allow.description:
Allow is the control plane's allowlist, LocalAllow the one
ghost_set_policy sets (null when the host has set none).

local.description:
Local is the host application's policy, Effective the combination of it
and the control plane's that the exit enforces.

used_bytes.description:
UsedBytes and LimitBytes are today's usage against the effective daily
cap (a limit of 0 means unlimited).

active.description: Active is the number of live proxied connections.

ExitStatus.description: exitView is the node's exit in a status snapshot.

HostCount.description: HostCount is one entry of the capped top-N denied hosts.

LocalPolicy.description: localPolicy is the caps and pause flag the host application owns.

connections.description: Connections holds up to metrics.DefaultConnections records.

Metrics.description:
metricsView is the JSON ghost_metrics_json returns: the node's metrics
snapshot and its recent exit connections, newest first.

port.description: Port is the tunnel-side TCP port (0 = metrics.DefaultPort).

MetricsConfig.description:
metricsConfig turns the in-tunnel metrics endpoint on. It listens inside the
netstack on the node's tunnel IP, so only the netmap's hubs can reach it.

online.description:
Online is what the control plane says; Linked is whether this node has
a live WireGuard tunnel to the peer.

candidate_type.description:
CandidateType is the selected local ICE candidate type: host, srflx,
prflx or relay. It is empty until the link is up.

Peer.description: peerView is one netmap peer and the tunnel to it.

address.description: Address is the peer's tunnel address (CIDR).

candidate_type.description:
CandidateType is the selected local ICE candidate type (host, srflx,
prflx or relay).

rtt_seconds.description: RTTSeconds is the ICE round-trip time (0 when not yet measured).

last_handshake.description:
LastHandshake is the last WireGuard handshake (zero when none yet), and
HandshakeAgeSeconds its age at snapshot time.

rx_bytes.description: RxBytes and TxBytes are transport bytes received from / sent to the peer.

PeerStat.description: PeerStat is the tunnel state of one peer.

allow.description:
Allow replaces the local allowlist ("host", "host:port",
"*.example.com:443"). An empty array denies every destination; null
leaves the current list in place.

daily_bytes.description: DailyBytes is the local per-UTC-day byte budget (0 = no local cap).

bytes_per_second.description: BytesPerSecond is the local throughput cap (0 = no local cap).

paused.description: Paused refuses new exit connections while true.

Policy.description:
policyRequest is the JSON body of ghost_set_policy. Every field is
optional: an absent field leaves that part of the local policy alone, so
{"paused":true} pauses and changes nothing else.

The local policy never widens the control plane's: a destination must pass
both allowlists, the effective cap is the smaller non-zero of the two, and
the exit is paused when either side pauses it.

ProtocolStat.description: ProtocolStat aggregates one proxy protocol ("socks5" or "http_connect") over one transport ("tcp").

ResultStat.description: ResultStat counts connections with one result.

peer_id.description:
PeerID and Address identify the node and its tunnel address, when
known.

Snapshot.description: Snapshot is a point-in-time view of a node's metrics.

SourceStat.description: SourceStat aggregates one source: the requesting peer and the source part of the tag it sent (see exit.ParseSourceTag).

creds.description: Creds are the control-plane credentials, as written by ghost_enroll.

key_store_path.description:
KeyStorePath is the file the WireGuard key pair is persisted in. Empty
means an ephemeral key, which enrols the peer's key afresh on every
run; a host application should always pass a path in its own storage.

private_key.description:
PrivateKey is the WireGuard private key (base64), for a host that keeps
it in its own secret store: nothing is then read from or written to
disk. It excludes KeyStorePath.

ca_cert_pem.description:
CACertPEM holds PEM certificate authorities trusted, on top of the
system roots, for a wss:// control plane behind a private CA.

roles.description:
Roles are the roles this member asks the control plane to grant it
("node", "exit", "hub", "relay"). Exit.Enabled adds "exit".

stun.description:
STUN are STUN URLs, TURN are TURN servers with credentials. Both are
merged with whatever the control plane advertises.

port_min.description: PortMin and PortMax bound the local UDP port range ICE binds (0 = any).

mtu.description: MTU is the tunnel MTU (0 = ghost.DefaultMTU).

dns.description: DNS are DNS servers for the tunnel netstack.

connect_timeout_ms.description:
ConnectTimeoutMS bounds ICE connection establishment per peer
(0 = the library default).

log_level.description:
LogLevel is "debug", "info", "warn" or "error" (default "warn"). Logs
go to the process's standard error.

exit.description: Exit configures the SOCKS5 / HTTP-CONNECT exit on the tunnel IP.

metrics.description:
Metrics configures the in-tunnel metrics endpoint. ghost_metrics_json
works whether or not it is enabled.

StartConfig.description:
startConfig is the JSON body of ghost_start. Unknown fields are refused:
a misspelt key_store_path would otherwise silently make the WireGuard key
ephemeral.

ok.description: OK is false only on the error form, which carries Error instead.

handle.description: Handle is the node's handle, echoed back.

connected.description:
Connected is true while the node is usable: the signalling session is
up and the control plane has the node in its network.

signal_state.description:
SignalState is disconnected, connecting, connected or closed. It says
nothing about the join: a node whose join the control plane refused
(because its owner paused it, say) stays connected and unjoined while
it keeps asking.

joined.description:
Joined is whether the node is in its network. While it is false the
node carries no traffic and lists no peers.

peer_id.description: PeerID is the control plane's id for this peer.

address.description:
Address is this node's tunnel address in CIDR form
("100.64.0.5/32"); TunnelAddress is the bare IP ("100.64.0.5").

roles.description:
Roles are this peer's roles, as the netmap reports them (the requested
roles until the first netmap arrives).

isolation.description: Isolation is the network's isolation mode ("none" or "hub-only").

peer_count.description:
PeerCount is the number of linked tunnel peers, NetmapPeers the number
the netmap lists.

peers.description: Peers is every netmap peer, sorted by peer id.

exit.description: Exit is the node's exit, or null when it serves none.

Status.description:
statusView is the JSON ghost_status_json returns: what the node's Status
reports, its tunnel address, every peer in the netmap with the state of the
tunnel to it, and the exit.

active.description: Active is the number of live proxied connections.

denied.description: Denied counts connections refused by policy or the safety guard.

cap_used_bytes.description:
CapUsedBytes and CapLimitBytes are today's usage against the daily cap
(a limit of 0 means unlimited).

paused.description: Paused is true while the owner has paused the exit.
